note: All 55 GTA VI PS5 trophies with official names and descriptions, verified 21 Nov 2026 against the Exophase-derived list (PlanetGTA6), PowerPyx, and PSN-derived lists.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.target: Unlock all 54 other trophies
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum, so it pops automatically once every other trophy is yours. Work through the story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then mop up the remaining side trophies in free-roam. Keep one playthrough cheat-free, since cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.target: Complete the mission Gone Fishing
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission of Chapter 1, so just play the story from the start and it unlocks on its own. There is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss here. It should be one of the first trophies you earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.target: Finish all Chapter 1 story missions
trophies.guide: Play through every main mission in Chapter 1 in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one missable meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter as a safety net.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.target: Finish all Chapter 2 story missions
trophies.guide: Keep playing the main story through Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. The asterisks are part of the official name as shown on PSN. From this chapter on you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which opens up partner activities.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.target: Finish all Chapter 3 story missions
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3 to unlock this. This chapter introduces several systems that later trophies need, including jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner, and Payday Loans robberies. Take the optional missions as they appear, since they feed into other trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.target: Finish all Chapter 4 story missions
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4's main missions to the end and the trophy unlocks automatically. Chapter 4 also opens the large bank vault robberies, which you will need for Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist. Do those vault jobs as they are offered.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.target: Complete the final story mission
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story and this Gold trophy pops. After the credits you return to free-roam, so nothing is locked off by finishing. Make a manual save before the finale so you can keep a clean pre-ending state.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.target: Complete the mission Breakfast Run
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a main story mission in Chapter 2, so it unlocks automatically as you play through the chapter. Just follow the pink main-mission markers on the map. There is no special requirement beyond finishing the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.target: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a main story mission in Chapter 3, so it unlocks by playing the story. Follow the mission marker when it appears and complete the heist. No side preparation is needed for this one.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.target: Complete the mission Child's Play
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a main story mission in Chapter 4, so it unlocks automatically during the story. Keep following the main missions and it will pop when the mission ends. Nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.target: Complete the mission Headliners
trophies.guide: Headliners is a main story mission in Chapter 4, so it unlocks by playing through the chapter. Just complete the mission when it comes up in the story order. No extra steps are required.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.target: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a main story mission in Chapter 4, so it unlocks automatically as you progress. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. The airport area from this mission is also where Catch Me If You Can takes place later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.target: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a main story mission in Chapter 5, so it unlocks by playing the story to that point. Complete the mission and the trophy pops. It is one of the last story trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.target: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist
trophies.guide: The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. It is more forgiving than true 100%: most tasks only need a share of the total, such as 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races, and Bret's hunts need everything, so clear those fully and pick the easiest options elsewhere.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.target: Complete any 250 stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in total across four types: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights between buildings, and base jumps. You can mix types freely, and flying under bridges is the quickest to rack up. Track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and note that the 100% checklist wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.target: Try all 9 activity types once
trophies.guide: The game counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Progress, then Activities, to see which types you still need. Most come up naturally in the story, so just try any missing one once and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.target: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges with 42 challenges between them, and you need gold in every one. Take your time, aim for the high-value targets first, and replay any challenge you miss. Shooting range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.target: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations with 42 races between them, and you need at least one win at each location. Learn the racing line at each spot and cut corners where the course allows. The drone races also count toward the 100% checklist, so they are worth clearing fully.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.target: Win 20 different races
trophies.guide: There are 40 unique race locations, and you need to win 20 different ones. Pick the short, easy races first and use a fast car you are comfortable with. Each location only counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of repeating the same race.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot west of Key Lento. Go there and take on his fishing challenge. Keep your line tension steady and reel in smoothly to out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.target: Finish any one arcade game
trophies.guide: There are four arcade games, and finishing all levels of any one of them unlocks the trophy. Three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, and the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. Pick whichever game you enjoy most and play through to its end; bonus challenges are not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.target: Finish Andy's 5-mission questline (Lucia only)
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. She will get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Complete all five of her quests, ending with the warehouse meeting, and the trophy pops. The whole line stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.target: Clear all 7 of Kenton's shipwreck treasure sets
trophies.guide: Kenton's line is marked automatically in Chapter 1, and he will call you after the Island Dreams mission. He marks purple treasure chests on the map; dive to each shipwreck, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. After each set he calls again with more locations, seven sets in total. He goes quiet for a while in the story but comes back, so the line is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.target: Finish Billy's 5-mission questline at Thrillbilly Mudclub
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Work through his five jobs, including the mud club visit and stealing the Impaler. All of his quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.target: Complete 8 counting Strangers & Freaks strands
trophies.guide: Not every side questline counts toward this trophy, so stick to the confirmed strangers: Kirk and his Skunk Ape search, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street races, and Pilot Pete and his deliveries. Each strand is several missions long. You can track your count in the trophy list, and all of them remain available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.target: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List
trophies.guide: Randy's line starts after the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for him, which also unlocks the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if they are on his list, then drive them back in good condition for a better payout. Cars he marks on the map are the easiest finds, and new ones get marked as you deliver.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.target: Destroy the Synthetic Labs, then finish Tyrone's final quest
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City; destroy enough of them and Tyrone will offer his second quest, Spin On This. Finish that quest to unlock the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.target: Meditate at every meditation spot (18 spots, 10 locations)
trophies.guide: This is the only potentially missable trophy, so handle it early. In Chapter 1, after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she will say she is going to meditate and walk to the balcony, so follow her and accept. After that, visit all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, meditating with both Jason and Lucia at each spot where possible. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.target: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text from him. Meet Bret in Lummox County to start the hunting quests. He marks hunting spots on the map and asks for specific animals; bring them back to him as Jason. His first quest also gives you a unique hunting rifle, and one clean shot keeps the animal in pristine condition.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.target: Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets
trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida, and you only need to finish three of them. Pick the sets whose cards are clustered in areas you already visit, and grab cards as you explore rather than hunting them all at once. Cards found in story buildings also appear elsewhere, so none are missable.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.target: Scan 100 WAiNK locations
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan landmarks, curiosities, and sculptures by aiming at them. There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so any 100 will do. Scan things as you travel and explore, and the total builds up quickly without any dedicated grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.target: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and you only need 50 for this trophy. Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this until late and then pick the easiest remaining ones. You can track them under Progress, then Challenges, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this unlocks on the way there.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.target: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner
trophies.guide: This unlocks once you can free-roam with your partner, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner, then cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast motorcycle, cutting through traffic and side streets until you leave the red heat zone. A train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a handy escape route, since police struggle to follow you there.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.target: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, staying wanted
trophies.guide: Once you can switch characters and call your partner, bring them along and rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level drop. Bring body armor, sticky bombs, and healing items, and loot each shop properly before moving to the next. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are a good run, and the trophy pops shortly after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.target: Discover 100 different vehicles
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan vehicles you see; just looking at a new one and scanning it counts, and you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic to rack up discoveries fast. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.target: Defeat 5 enemies in one Combat Focus use
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is triggered while aiming by pressing both stick buttons, slowing time and highlighting weak spots. It only lasts a few seconds, so raise your Focus level first through shooting ranges, golf, pool, and fishing, and use Adrenaline to stretch the effect. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle. It does not seem to count against police, soldiers, or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: Steal a docked passenger plane at VCIA and fly 1 km away
trophies.guide: Go to Vice City International Airport and find a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal, connected to a boarding bridge; the easiest one is at terminals E3/E4. Get inside, climb to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy unlocks. You can enter through the terminal on foot or drive through a fence onto the airfield.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.target: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station
trophies.guide: Head to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where tanks sit in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump near the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank. Shoot at the soldiers who attack you and the trophy unlocks shortly after.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.target: Rob a jewelry store stealthily, undetected
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in. Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm, then leave quietly. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot for it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.target: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape
trophies.guide: Bank vault robberies open in Chapter 4 with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van to a bank and slip into the vault while it is open. Bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each to find more banks. There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy comes on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.target: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat
trophies.guide: The easiest way is through the Chapter 4 mission that introduces bank vault robberies, since robbing the vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. You can also do it earlier: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, and blow its back door open with a sticky bomb. Either way, escape the red heat radius afterwards to make it pop.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.target: Fully unfog the whole map
trophies.guide: You need to clear all the black fog from the map by visiting every area. The fastest way is to fly a plane over the fogged regions until the whole map is visible. Work outward from the areas you already know, and check the map regularly for remaining dark patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.target: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running 39 illegal operations, and you need to rob at least one operation from each gang. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically during the story. You can check your progress per gang under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this comes on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.target: Buy and drink an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing at the bar with the view in front of you and the trophy unlocks. It is a quick one-off, so do it whenever you are passing through Vice Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window
trophies.guide: First unlock the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy. Then go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, find the blue Banshee inside, and use the Key Cloner to get into it. Drive straight forward through the showroom window and keep going down the street; the trophy pops a moment later. It only works with that specific blue Banshee.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.target: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation that gets marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside you need three valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, a unique shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which opens with code 0300 or a sticky bomb. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time
trophies.guide: Once you can switch characters after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, start training both of them. Buy a gym membership and always bring your partner along, since the partner trains automatically while you work out. Check each character's strength under their character menu and keep going until both are maxed at the same time. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.target: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile
trophies.guide: You need 500 actions that shift your criminal profile, and you can watch the count by selecting the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications in the settings so you see a small icon whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy escapes, fights, and clean getaways all add up, and most players reach 500 naturally while clearing the other trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.target: As Lucia alone, rob the Little Cuba Payday Loans again and escape on foot
trophies.guide: During the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store, and this trophy is for doing it again later. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Then go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba as Lucia, alone without Jason, aim at the teller, deal with the security, and empty the three cash drawers. Escape on foot, not in a vehicle, and keep running until you are clear of the police search area.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.target: Complete the UFO easter egg north-west of Starlet Motel after 2AM
trophies.guide: Go alone at night, after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO. Walk toward it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is a little random, so be patient.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.target: Kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds
trophies.guide: Ride any bike into a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach and kick pedestrians with the melee button while riding past them. You need 10 kicks within 60 seconds, so keep moving through the crowd instead of stopping. Expect a wanted level, so pick a busy stretch where you can keep riding in a loop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.target: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills via fences
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and take the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total builds up across all your robberies, and a single bank vault can give up to $205,000 once those open in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.target: Spend $100,000 total across all shops
trophies.guide: Just spend $100,000 in total across any shops in the game. Guns, car modifications, and tattoos are the fastest way to reach the total, since they are the most expensive items. The counter adds up across every shop type, so your normal spending during the game already makes progress.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.target: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total)
trophies.guide: There are 8 garages you can buy, costing $160,000 in total, plus 4 story-related garages that do not count. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them all through the app; robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 are the best way to earn the cash. More garages also add parking spots for the On the Spot trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.target: Register 10 vehicles via Scooter Bros
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and then Register in his garage. You need enough garage space first, so buy garages for the Little Boxes trophy if you run out of spots. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the registration cost down, and later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at Pay 'n' Sprays.
